references.text: The description of a man possessed by an unclean spirit who meets Jesus as he comes out of the boat, and how Jesus cleanses him.
A parallel event where Jesus meets two men possessed by demons in the region of the Gerasenes, demonstrating Jesus' power over evil spirits.
Luke's version of the event where Jesus cleanses a man possessed by demons in the land of the Gerasenes, and how the cleansed man wishes to follow Jesus.
